analysis_amendment_disclosure.claim_boundary: A2 is reported as a transparent post hoc statistical correction, not as a blinded or fully prespecified analysis.
analysis_amendment_disclosure.reason: The review identified that nonparametric event resampling gives a degenerate [1, 1] interval when every catalog event is hit. A2 replaces that interval with event-level Wilson uncertainty and adds dependence and panel diagnostics.
analysis_amendment_disclosure.timing: Provisional event-derived aggregate metrics were inspected during internal statistical review before A2 was frozen. The complete event-plus-continuous-background final analysis did not yet exist.

catalog_event_hit_interval.estimand: Fraction of catalog events with at least one matched positive-time-weight P-reference station.
catalog_event_hit_interval.reason: A nonparametric event bootstrap degenerates to [1, 1] when every observed event is hit and would incorrectly express zero binomial uncertainty.

continuous_panel_sensitivity.interpretation: All date-resampling intervals are conditional on the fixed six-station panel.

hit_windows.denominator: Every frozen positive-weight station reference, with pre-scoring technical unavailability retained as a miss. A scoring exception aborts the evaluation instead of being converted to a record-level miss.
hit_windows.rule: Select the nearest candidate within the frozen +/-1.5 s endpoint once, then report nested absolute pick-error indicators at 0.5, 1.0, and 1.5 s.

network_confirmation.candidate_grouping: Sort all station candidates by estimated P epoch. Starting at the earliest remaining candidate, form an inclusive 10 s estimated-P window. Count at most one confirmation and skip the whole window when it contains at least three distinct stations; otherwise advance one candidate.
network_confirmation.contributing_station_rule: Within a qualifying group, retain each station's earliest-available candidate and choose the first three by available epoch, station key, then estimated P epoch.
network_confirmation.denominator: The original post-quarantine exact time with at least three stations simultaneously available.
network_confirmation.exposure_alignment: Retain a grouped confirmation in the rate numerator only when the three stations contributing the selected candidates all have quality-valid masks at its release epoch. Other valid stations cannot substitute for a contributing station. Report the unrestricted grouped count as a diagnostic.
network_confirmation.release_epoch: Available epoch of the third selected distinct-station candidate.

analysis_corrections.seed_robustness: Report the availability-aware primary-station recall range in addition to event hit and background candidate ranges.

snr_strata.left_censor_reporting: Report the count left-censored at -120 dB when post-P excess power is nonpositive.
snr_strata.technical_unavailability: Map pre-scoring technical unavailability to the declared invalid-or-unavailable stratum.

station_cluster_sensitivity.interpretation: Complements the primary event-cluster analysis by measuring sensitivity to repeated stations; neither interval is a claim of network-population sampling.
station_cluster_sensitivity.method: Resample station keys with replacement and retain all primary P-reference rows for each sampled station.

claim_boundary.background: Quiet-background records estimate candidate and network-confirmation rates over measured station/network exposure.
claim_boundary.final_holdout: The 2026 GeoNet period is accessed only after development arm, threshold, and primary seed were sealed.
claim_boundary.network_confirmation: Three-station temporal confirmation is secondary and does not define the primary record-level picker result.
claim_boundary.technical_availability: Model performance on technically scorable stations and availability-aware operational performance use separate denominators.
